headline: Approved correcting the legal entity name for 111 Winooski Falls Way to ORH Operations LLC.
summary: The meeting had one consent agenda item. The Onion River Hotel's legal entity name was corrected to ORH Operations LLC after a recent inspection by the Department of Liquor and Lottery.
decisions: Approved correcting the legal entity name from Onion River Hotel to ORH Operations LLC, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion: Motion to approve the technicality by Councilor Goodrich and seconded by Deputy Mayor Oakleaf to approve the name of the entity to ORH Operations LLC. Motion passed 4-0.

A. Discussion/Approval: ORH Operations LLC- 111 Winooski Falls Way- correcting legal
entity from “Onion River Hotel” to ORH Operations LLC
Minutes: The City Clerk presented this technicality in the name of the Entity. On August 3, 2026, the 
Liquor Control Board approved the Third, First, Outside Consumption Permit, Restaurant and 
Entertainment Licenses for Onion River Hotel. During the recent inspection from Department of Liquor 
and Lottery, it was discovered the entity needed to be “ORH Operations, LLC). Staff has no concerns. 
Motion: Motion to approve the technicality by Councilor Goodrich and seconded by Deputy Mayor 
Oakleaf to approve the name of the entity to ORH Operations LLC. Motion passed 4-0.
